identity.title: Qualify the existing Completeness known-cell golden suite

origin.kind: master backlog continuation approved by the user
origin.summary: M-15 remained Not Started even though the existing 30-case Completeness verifier already exercises the required known-cell matrix and the CI workflow invokes it.

state.current_summary: M-15 is closed by qualifying the existing 30/30 Completeness verifier and requiring its exact complete-report header in the existing CI step; no product or verifier assertions changed.

objective.summary: Qualify M-15 by proving the existing Completeness known-cell golden suite and making CI reject a partial or stale report.
constraints: Reuse the existing verifier, Runner command, and CI step; do not add a duplicate assertion framework or product implementation.
Preserve exact known-cell geometry, coverage, missing-count, relative-height, decision, source-immutability, runner-parity, and export contracts.
Do not change UI, schema, recipe behavior, product version, R0, or release behavior.

criteria.text: The golden suite verifies the exact four-cell IDs, geometry, coverage ratios, missing counts, and relative heights.
The suite verifies inclusive decision boundaries, the exact aggregate of two passing and two failing cells, and failure of the all-missing cell.

The suite verifies deterministic direct/repeat/ordered Runner parity, source immutability, exact schema 1.9 JSON/HTML/CSV evidence, fail-closed malformed or missing current evidence, and readable legacy evidence.
The existing CI command requires the exact complete marker C3DCompletenessGridGoldenVerification|PASS|cases=30|passed=30|failed=0 while adjacent verification commands remain unchanged.
Current-tree Release build, Runner golden verification, standard test facade, NuGet provenance, structure guard, SDK package guard, issue validation, documentation links, and diff checks pass.

evidence.observation: The current existing verifier passed 30/30. It proved the four exact row-major IDs and 2x2 regions, coverage 1/0.75/0.5/0, missing counts 0/1/2/4, relative heights 2/4/-2/missing, inclusive Pass/Fail/Pass/Fail decisions, aggregate pass 2/fail 2, all-missing failure, immutable source SHA-256, deterministic direct/adapter/ordered output SHA-256, exact schema 1.9 JSON/HTML/CSV cells, fail-closed missing or malformed current evidence, and readable schema 1.8 evidence.

The existing hosted Runner step still invokes --verify-c3d-completeness-grid exactly once and now throws unless the same report contains C3DCompletenessGridGoldenVerification|PASS|cases=30|passed=30|failed=0. Adjacent Runner commands remain in place.

Current-tree checks passed with the corrected repository-supported artifacts-path isolation: 15-project Release build 0 warnings/errors, Completeness 30/30 and 12 selected exact contract lines, standard facade 2/2, NuGet 15 projects with vulnerable/deprecated 0/0, structure 68/68, fixed Vision SDK identity/checksum, inventory 147 C/47 N, and documentation target checks. The initial shared BaseIntermediateOutputPath attempt failed from generated-assets collisions and its log is retained; hosted CI and UI runtime were not run.
After the final documentation and issue update, PL-0042 validates as v2, the tracked migration baseline JSON parses, all four required durable paths exist, and git diff --check passes.

events.summary: Resolved after all five acceptance criteria received current evidence.
